link_types.name: portal_po_to_fm_generated_po
link_types.description: Link contract portal-po-to-fm-generated-po (json_path): A Portal purchase order is the copy of this FM generated purchase order; custom_fields.fmGeneratedPoId is the only link (po_number is rewritten to the BC No.).

evidence.note: link contract portal-po-to-fm-generated-po: A Portal purchase order is the copy of this FM generated purchase order; custom_fields.fmGeneratedPoId is the only link (po_number is rewritten to the BC No.).
link contract portal-po-line-to-po: A Portal purchase order line belongs to this Portal purchase order.

link_types.name: portal_receipt_to_po_by_number_text
link_types.description: Link contract portal-receipt-to-po-by-number-text (text_match): A receipt's PO number text equals a purchase order's number after trimming. A LEAD only: po_number gets an -FM<id> suffix on clashes and is rewritten to the BC No., and the text is not unique over time.

evidence.note: link contract portal-receipt-to-po-by-number-text: A receipt's PO number text equals a purchase order's number after trimming. A LEAD only: po_number gets an -FM<id> suffix on clashes and is rewritten to the BC No., and the text is not unique over time.

link contract portal-receipt-to-po-by-id: A Portal receipt stores this purchase order's id, but the column is loose text that Portal filled by matching TRIM(po_number) = ponoqc. Agreement is recorded as stored_by_text_join, never as a verified link, and cannot support a relation claim; a stored id that differs still contradicts.

link_types.name: fm_po_item_to_fm_po

evidence.note: link contract fm-po-item-to-fm-po: An FM purchase order line belongs to this FM generated purchase order (gpi.idpogen = gpo.id).

link_types.name: fm_packaging_receipt_to_po_item
link_types.description: Link contract fm-packaging-receipt-to-po-item (fk): An FM packaging receipt detail was received against this FM purchase order line (idpogenitem = gpi.id). Unlike the Portal receipt's PO number text, this is an id.
